name: NGC 7541 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7541, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n7541-hubble
story: A barred spiral forming stars at a higher-than-usual rate, a hint that its bar funnels gas inward to feed new stars. With its nearby companion, NGC 7537, it makes up a pair of galaxies.

claims.text: NGC 7541 is a barred spiral galaxy
It has a higher-than-usual star formation rate
Bars funnel material inward to make new stars
It forms a pair with companion NGC 7537
